terra.problem: “Solomon’s dream” says “That night,” but 1 Kings 3:5 says “One night at Gibeon” and does not explicitly say it was the night after the sacrifices. Use “One night” or add 2 Chronicles 1:6–7, which says “That night.”
“The sun stands still” says the sun stopped “for about a full day.” Joshua 10:13 says it stopped and delayed going down about a full day. Use the verse’s wording for precision.
“Seeking the counsel of the LORD” may be difficult at a fifth-grade reading level. Consider “asking the LORD for guidance.”
